args.title: Fix issue 4191 in README.md
args.body:
File: README.md

The README.md instructs to run 'npm run serve' to start the API, but the package.json does not have a 'serve' script; it has only 'start', 'build', 'test', and 'lint'. The README should be corrected to use 'npm run start' instead of 'npm run serve'.

label: bug
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The README.md instructs to run 'npm run serve' to start the API, but the package.json does not have a 'serve' script; it has only 'start', 'build', 'test', and 'lint'. The README should be corrected to use 'npm run start' instead of 'npm run serve'.
